g.text: can you tell me more about ordis?
do you have many friends in the future?
Sure. What do you want to know?
like people who're gonna miss you?
who was he before he was reprogrammed?
Nobody special. Just somebody who pissed off the Orokin real badly.
Ordan Karris. The Beast of Bones.
Yeah. He slept with Executor Ballas's wife. [Lie.]
No. I just don't want to fuel your weird obsession.
i want an epic name like that
He tries his best to keep me safe.
AMIR BECKETT THE DEVOURER OF SOULS
it sounds like he'll really miss you
And before you start off on your OML CEPHALON obsession, let me finish.
He's used to waiting centuries for me.
He's got the kid to worry about.
Ordis... he's my friend. But he was programmed to be that way. To serve the Tenno. To be our loyal protector. Forever.
so they turned him into a cephalon?
i feel like i missed something
you two have a kid together?!?!?!
and programmed him to serve you?
He was a mercenary in service to the Orokin.
yeah you're right doesn't really capture my charming personality anyway you were saying?
I really don't want to talk about this. [End.]
What?! NO!! No, I mean there's another version of me!
I'm going to go die now. [End.]
how much of his original self is left?
They brought him to the great chamber, and... offered to make him an Orokin like them.
I'm one half of a paradox that was created a long time ago.
He doesn't even remember he used to be someone else.
wow... refused all that power and wealth and immortality? dude was hella dope
Long story short, I aged and the kid didn't. So Ordis kind of looks over us both.
A sort of disembodied, digital consciousness. A glass brain.
He just hated them that much.
He wanted to go out bloody.
Made by the Orokin as a form of ultimate punishment, worse than death.
they can take memories, too? i guess that makes sense... rewrite the code, rewrite the hard drive...
So he killed every single one he could get his hands on. Or so he thought he did. But Orokin are very, very hard to kill.
oh yeah way more normal, can't see why i didn't jump straight to that conclusion
Reprogrammed to the Orokin's whim and liking, and set to serve for eternity.
but i still think the concept of cephalons are awesome
well now that i have a new fun thing to think about including 'paradox mini YOU' stuck in my head
i dunno, sounds pretty awesome to me
You're going to give me a drinking problem, I swear...
Amir, you're STILL missing the point!!
imma go smash some buttons in the arcade 'n we can catch up later
lol you really DO sound like arthur if he still had a normal liver i'd be murdering it right now
And made him chipper. And happy. And loyal. And gone is the bloody mercenary that was.
holy shit... so how much of the original ordis is left?
I feel like you didn't read what I just wrote there.
be immortal, get to edit out the parts of yourself you don't like?
be immortal, get to edit out the parts of yourself you don't like?
... wow those orokin people were DICKS
sounds like a sweet gig to me
just sounds like the guys doing the programming were assholes, right?
like, if you had a ray that cured cancer but had an OPTIONAL setting to turn people into zombies
would you call the invention a failure because one person kept the OPTIONAL setting on?
I... don't like it when you make sense, Amir.
I don't think you understand the ramifications of what I'm describing.
lol now you sound like arthur
psssh don't be sore that i'm right it's okay
imma go have a think we'll talk again soon byyyyeee
